effective_date_reading: No effective-date wording for sec. 2; 'The following executive actions are hereby revoked', so the revocation of EO 14026 took effect on signing, 2025-03-14 (printed 90 FR 13037-13038, March 20, 2025).

targets_in_batch_08.EO:14026: sec. 2(d) ('Executive Order 14026 of April 27, 2021 (Increasing the Minimum Wage for Federal Contractors)') among the executive actions that 'are hereby revoked': whole order, no qualifier, no exception, no savings and no direction about the implementing regulations or contract clauses.

conclusion: EO 14236 (signed 2025-03-14, 90 FR 13037-13038, read once in full) states its purpose (sec. 1), revokes eighteen executive orders, memoranda and determinations including EO 14026 (sec. 2(a)-(r)) and has general provisions (sec. 3). It has no savings, transition, exception or rescission-direction provision: unlike EO 13990 sec. 7(f) or EO 14032 sec. 4 it says nothing about rules, regulations or contract clauses issued under the revoked orders.
